summary: VistaOne, L.P. filed an 8-K reporting unregistered sales of limited partnership units totaling ~$170.2M across Class B, I, and S to third-party investors under Section 4(a)(2)/Reg D/S. The filing also discloses the March 31, 2026 Transactional NAV per unit for each class and notes the transition from anchor to standard unit classes. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, or other special-situation event. This is a routine periodic disclosure of ongoing private placements and net asset value calculation, not a transformative corporate action.
